mapper.sql: LOG_ID, REQUEST_ID, INTERFACE_TYPE, REQUEST_TIME, REQUEST_URL, REQUEST_METHOD, REQUEST_HEADERS, REQUEST_BODY, RESPONSE_TIME, RESPONSE_STATUS, RESPONSE_HEADERS, RESPONSE_BODY, IS_SUCCESSFUL, ERROR_MESSAGE, ELAPSED_TIME, CONNECTION_CONFIG_ID, BANK_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, OPERATION_TYPE, CLIENT_IP, CREATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUCCESSFUL = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUCCESSFUL = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failCount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUCCESSFUL = 1 THEN ELAPSED_TIME ELSE 0 END) as totalElapsed, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_SUCCESSFUL = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as successRate FROM TC_BANK_CONNECT_LOG
SELECT INTERFACE_TYPE as interfaceType, COUNT(*) as count FROM TC_BANK_CONNECT_LOG GROUP BY INTERFACE_TYPE
SELECT IS_SUCCESSFUL as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM TC_BANK_CONNECT_LOG GROUP BY IS_SUCCESSFUL
SELECT FROM TC_BANK_CONNECT_LOG WHERE IS_SUCCESSFUL = 0 ORDER BY REQUEST_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TC_BANK_CONNECT_LOG WHERE CREATE_TIME < SYSDATE - #{days}
